_purpose: JUDGEMENT layer, deliberately separate from data/audit/dossiers.json which holds only quoted findings. Rated for one goal: reaching 18/30 by drilling past papers. Override freely.

_rubric.1: Solved past papers for many sessions, single assessment, no gate beyond 18 overall.
_rubric.2: Past papers or samples exist; one straightforward written or coursework assessment.
_rubric.3: Either no published papers, or two components to satisfy, or a large syllabus (12 CFU).
_rubric.4: Independent pass gates, negative marking, or a compulsory oral on top of a written part.
_rubric.5: Rules not published anywhere reachable, or several gates at once; cannot be drilled blind.

504464.assessment_format: 8 Learning Tests, each <=25 min, 30 MCQ x 4 options each; final mark = AVERAGE of the 8 section marks, rounded 0.25 up
504464.partial_credit: Learning Tests taken during the course carry into the exam and are confirmed ('With the enrolment to the exam the learning tests carried out during the course are valid'). You did not attend, so ALL 8 are sat on the exam date.
504464.pass_gates: 18/30; NEGATIVE MARKING +1 correct, -1 wrong, 0 blank (true/false items +-0.5)
504464.why: Now fully verified from the ODT 'EXAM' file. 8 sections x 30 questions = 240 MCQs over Daft chapters 1-13 in one sitting (~3h20m), with -1 per wrong answer. With 4 options, a random guess has EV -0.5, so blind guessing is strongly negative. Much harsher than the 6 CFU label suggests.
